analyticsText: With your analytics consent, we use PostHog to measure page visits, referral sources, checklist use and successful enquiries. We do not send names, email addresses, phone numbers or messages to PostHog. Session recording and automatic capture of form interactions are disabled. Data is sent to PostHog’s EU cloud. You can withdraw consent in Cookie settings in the footer.
